neighbours.label: the piece ' lo' that begins 'loaves'
fire: The baker pulled six golden loaves from the oven.
We shared two warm loaves of bread at dinner.
Each morning the bakery sells forty loaves of sourdough.
She wrapped the banana loaves in foil for the trip.
The monks bake round loaves of rye every Friday.
Three loaves of bread and a jar of honey sat on the table.
The recipe makes two small loaves or one large one.
He carried the fresh loaves home in a paper bag.
quiet: The baker pulled six golden rolls from the oven.
We shared two warm baguettes at dinner.
Each morning the bakery sells forty pastries.
She wrapped the banana muffins in foil for the trip.
The monks bake round cakes of rye every Friday.
Three slices of bread and a jar of honey sat on the table.
The recipe makes two small pies or one large one.
He carried the fresh bagels home in a paper bag.

notes: Card: ' lo' x11 among top 32 (e.g. 'Sourdough Lo|aves'). Probes: 'loaves' 0.49-0.54; 'lobster', 'local', 'lots' and 'looms' ~0.01. The - pole fires on subjects of 'looms/approaches', and the output suppresses ' lo', so this is likely the 'loaves' vs 'looms' split of the same piece.
